inactiveStreams.reason: The source function first queries indicatorExecutions, then constructs a unique /indicatorExecutions({executionId})/IndicatorResultObjects URL for every returned execution. RestApiPoller cannot fan out a response into dynamic follow-up endpoints.
inactiveStreams.requiredResolution: Semperis supplies a flat/bulk results endpoint, or CCF adds response-driven fan-out.

partialStreams.reason: Child links are extracted without their parent attack-path Id.
Child Objects are extracted without their parent domain fields.

authAssumptions: CCF JwtToken requires username/password body fields. The candidate maps the API key to apiKey and adds ccfCompatibility=1. Semperis must confirm unknown JSON fields are ignored.
The returned Token is sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Semperis must confirm the Bearer prefix. CCF can omit the prefix, but cannot put the resulting JWT into each poll body.

pagination.publicSourceBehavior: No paging loops or CCF paging contract are present.
pagination.requiredConfirmation: Semperis must document page size/cursor/next-link behavior for value-array endpoints.
